caption: The video captures a large, translucent soap-film sheet suspended from a string loop against an overcast gray sky. A black pole with a bright green mid-section is gripped by a gloved hand at the left, while a second pole tip at the upper right joins a curved string that forms a wide V-shaped loop with a small dark connector at its lowest point. The iridescent film hangs like a long curtain, its surface showing shifting pink, green, and purple swirls. Throughout the clip the sheet extends downward, its rounded lower bulb drawing out into a tapering column that reaches the bottom edge. The color bands within the film continuously rearrange as the sheet flows and deforms. Meanwhile the gloved hand shifts partly out of view, the left pole changes angle, and the right tip becomes more visible, shifting the loop's position. The film's edges remain bound to the side strings, so the sheet stays attached to the loop as its lower part extends.
